issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (North America)

plan.diagnosis: Union Components Industries presents a medium-severity single-source sub-tier concentration risk with USD 1,835,816 in annual spend and 50 sub-tier suppliers, one of which is single-sourced in North America. The supplier experienced 1 disruption event in the trailing 12 months and has a resiliency score of 66, indicating moderate vulnerability to supply chain interruptions that could impact our production continuity.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier supplier mapping audit with Union Components Industries to identify the critical single-source sub-tier supplier and assess alternative sources within their network of 50 sub-tier suppliers
Collaborate with Union Components Industries to qualify and onboard at least one alternate sub-tier supplier for the critical component, including technical validation and quality approval
remedy_steps.owner: Supplier Quality Engineer & Procurement Category Manager

remedy_steps.step: Negotiate contractual terms with Union Components Industries requiring dual-source commitment at sub-tier level with minimum 30% allocation to alternate supplier
Implement quarterly sub-tier supply chain reviews with Union Components Industries to monitor resiliency metrics and sub-tier diversification progress

plan.expected_impact: Mitigating the single-source sub-tier risk will protect USD 1,835,816 in annual spend from potential disruption and improve supply chain resiliency score above the current 66.
kpis: Number of qualified alternate sub-tier suppliers (target: minimum 1 within 90 days)
Sub-tier supplier diversification ratio (target: no single sub-tier >70% of component volume)
Supplier resiliency score improvement (target: increase from 66 to 75+ within 6 months)
Disruption event frequency (target: reduce from 1 to 0 events per 12 months)
Sub-tier visibility coverage (target: 100% mapping of critical components)
risks: Union Components Industries may resist sub-tier transparency due to competitive concerns or existing supplier relationships
Alternate sub-tier qualification timeline may extend beyond 90 days if technical specifications are complex or quality standards are stringent
Additional costs of USD 50,000-100,000 may be incurred for dual-sourcing setup, tooling, and qualification testing
Incumbent single-source sub-tier supplier may offer price concessions that create internal pressure to maintain status quo
Volume split between sub-tier suppliers could reduce economies of scale and increase unit costs by 3-8%
erp_actions: SAP: Add info record note in LFA1 for Union Components Industries flagging sub-tier concentration risk and dual-source requirement
SAP: Create purchasing info record (EINE) with mandatory source list requirement once alternate is qualified
Oracle EBS: Update supplier profile with sub-tier risk flag and add notes documenting qualified alternate sub-tier suppliers
Coupa: Enable sub-tier supplier tracking in supplier record and configure risk alert for single-source dependencies
Dynamics 365: Add vendor category tag 'SUB_TIER_RISK_MITIGATION' to Union Components Industries for reporting visibility
All ERPs: Configure quarterly supplier scorecard review workflow incorporating resiliency score and sub-tier diversification metrics
